text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This debut race is full of promising<n>prospects who
just signed on with<n>new trainers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
At long last, I get to see the results of<n>my training.
It's time to focus and do<n>this!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I promise I won't let you down.<n>Let's take
home a win.
